title: Hajong language - Wikipedia
text: Hajong is an Indo-Aryan language [3] with a possible Tibeto-Burman language substratum. title: Hajong people - Wikipedia
text: The Hajong people are an ethnic group of Northeast India and northern parts of Bangladesh. [4] The majority of the Hajongs are settled in India and are predominantly rice-farmers.
